title: Coast Guard rescues two stranded by high tide at Ecola State Park
description:
A Coast Guard aircrew aboard an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter, from Sector Columbia River, hoists two stranded people to safety near the south end of Indian Beach within Ecola State Park, May 19, 2019.

The two individuals got stranded by the incoming tide, but were reportedly uninjured.

U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Sector Columbia River.
